segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to go over the kickoff feedback and make sure we’re still on track for the August 19 go-live with 48 seats.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We’re on track overall, but I need to be pretty direct. On the sales call we agreed that your team would import our last 18 months of calibration records before training. That was a big reason we signed the $42,600 order.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, I remember that. The historical import was included as part of the onboarding scope.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, because your implementation lead told my operations manager yesterday that they had no record of that and that we’d need to fill out templates ourselves after go-live. That was a surprise, and frankly it caused a mess internally.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s on us. I’m sorry. I documented it in my notes and on the pricing sheet, but I did not get that requirement into the handoff for the implementation group. So they walked into kickoff without the thing we agreed to, and that should not have happened.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I appreciate you saying that, but we already moved two supervisors’ schedules around. Training is Monday, and now they’re asking questions I thought were settled in June.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I’m going to correct the handoff today and put the import into the onboarding checklist as a deliverable, not an optional task. We’ll assign a data specialist by end of day, and we’ll use the export you sent on July 12.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you confirm there’s no added fee? I don’t want an invoice later for cleanup hours.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No added fee. The contract stays at $42,600, net 30, with the same 48 named users. I’ll send a short written confirmation after this call and copy the implementation lead so there’s no ambiguity.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. If the import can be completed before Friday at noon, we can keep the Monday training. If not, we need to move go-live to August 26.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s fair. I’ll have the team validate the file by tomorrow at 3 p.m. Central and give you a yes-or-no on the Friday noon completion. Again, apologies for the miss in the handoff.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send the confirmation and the revised kickoff notes today, and we’ll hold the schedule for now.
